column1: # doc-folders.tsv (harbor#1435) — the kind of a docs/ folder or file that standards/naming/kinds.tsv has no row for.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. bin/doc-shape.sh derives a doc's `kind` from the kinds.tsv row whose folder holds it, and a doc in a
# folder no row names has no kind to be held to. A repo adds the folder here instead of editing the shared registry.
#   folder   docs/<name>/ for a folder, or a docs/ file path for one file
